text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate (prod-us-west1). Error spike started ~1718009900. Pager: maya.zhao
maya.zhao: seeing 502/503 spike across gateway, latency up ~300ms. Looking into model runners.
oliver.kim: oncall here, logging into pool1 nodes now. Can someone post recent gateway logs?
sarah.li: customer-impact: briefly affecting interactive flows; CS reports ~12 paying customers seeing timeouts. Ticket inflight. @carla-cs FYI.
kevin: I'm pulling stacktraces from model-runner-3 (host: mr-runner-3). Getting repeated segfaults in quant_attention.so.
maya.zhao: stack trace excerpt: ```
signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8a3c0
#0 0x7f8a3c0 in quant_attention::forward
#1 0x7ef23b2 in model::generate
#2 0x7e9ab11 in worker::handle_request
```
ops-bot: Autorestart policy triggered for mr-runner-3 (3 restarts in 5m). Placing node into quarantine.
oliver.kim: quarantine node, good. Redirecting traffic off pool1 to pool2 (fallback model-small). Executing reroute now.
maya.zhao: reroute done via routing-control: ```
POST /routing/v1/route
{"selector":"/v1/generate","from":"pool1","to":"pool2","reason":"failover-segfault"}
```
kevin: pool2 (fallback) capacity ~60% used; expect some latency increase but should reduce errors. Monitoring.
sarah.li: notifying affected accounts with templated message. Carla, please escalate any enterprise customers who need manual outreach. :loudspeaker: 
carla-cs: on it, pinging top-5 customers and opening follow-ups.
maya.zhao: I'm collecting core dumps for mr-runner-3 and starting a hotpatch build to disable the quant_attention fast path (suspected regression from recent kernel). Building patch now.
kevin: temp mitigation: reduce batch size on pool1 runners from 8 -> 2 to avoid K/V cache pressure. Applying config: ```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/runner BATCH_SIZE=2 --record
```
ops-bot: Config rollout started for namespace inference; 15/30 pods updated.
oliver.kim: after reroute, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 2.5% across the fleet. Still seeing residual 502s from older sessions on pool1.
maya.zhao: hotpatch artifact available at s3://redwood-artifacts/hotpatch/quant-disable-171800.tar.gz. Rolling to quarantine group for verification.
kevin: core analysis notes: memory access in attention kernel triggers when sequence_len > 1024 with quantized int8 buffer reuse. Likely boundary check regression.
sarah.li: customer-impact update: CS estimates ~8 customers with degraded UX, severity high for 2 enterprise accounts. Preparing incident summary for postmortem.
oliver.kim: handoff: I'm staying on for next 30m to monitor, @maya.zhao you take lead on root cause. If error rate goes <1% for 15m, will mark mitigated.
maya.zhao: acknowledged. Continuing hotpatch verification.
ops-bot: Metric alert cleared for threshold 5xx > 10% (now 2.1%).
carla-cs: confirm outreach sent to affected customers, ticket links included, PS team standing by.
maya.zhao: hotpatch rolled to remaining pool1 runners (canary -> full). Watching logs.
kevin: after hotpatch, no further segfaults observed on quarantined host when replaying problematic trace.
oliver.kim: 5xx rate stable at 0.8% for last 10m. Ready to close pager in 20m unless regressions.
sarah.li: initiated incident bridge notes and customer-impact doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1718009999/summary (internal).
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Incident created 1718009999. Mitigation action: reroute -> fallback model, batch size reduction, hotpatch to attention kernel.
maya.zhao: root cause hypothesis: recent attention kernel change allowed out-of-bounds pointer for long sequences on quantized path. Fix included bounds checks + unit test; will include regression test for seq_len>1024.
carla-cs: final customer update drafted, awaiting legal review for two enterprise notices.
oliver.kim: closing on-call handoff in 10m. Thanks team. :tada:
incident-bot: Resolved at 1718010589. Postmortem assigned: eng-runtime@redwood and eng-ml.
